raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

At TP8, these FP8 models fail during server startup on ROCm, with AITER on and off, on MI300X and MI355X:

| Model | FP8 linear kernel | Failing layer | K per GPU at TP8 |
|---|---|---|---|
| RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 | `ROCmFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel` | layer 0 MLP `down_proj` | 10944 / 8 = 1368 |
| nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 | `ROCmFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel` | layer 0 MLP `down_proj` | 10944 / 8 = 1368 |
| RedHatAI/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic | `RowWiseTorchFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel` | dense MLP `down_proj`, every layer | 2112 / 8 = 264 |

* `RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8`
    * `vllm serve`:
      ```
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=0 vllm serve RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 --dtype auto -tp 8 --port 8000 --disable-uvicorn-access-log --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 4096 --kv-cache-dtype auto
      ```
    * Output:
      ```
      (Worker_TP0 pid=485966) ERROR 10-13 04:30:28 [multiproc_executor.py:1062] RuntimeError: Expected trailing dimension of mat1 to be divisible by 16 but got mat1 shape: (16384x1368).
      (EngineCore pid=485675) ERROR 10-13 04:30:28 [core.py:1495] RuntimeError: Worker failed with error 'Expected trailing dimension of mat1 to be divisible by 16 but got mat1 shape: (16384x1368).', please check the stack trace above for the root cause
      RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {}
      ```
* `RedHatAI/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic`
    * `vllm serve`:
      ```
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=0 vllm serve RedHatAI/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic --dtype auto -tp 8 --port 8000 --disable-uvicorn-access-log --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 4096 --kv-cache-dtype auto
      ```
    * Output:
      ```
      [rank6]:E1013 04:32:25.804000 488070 torch/_subclasses/fake_tensor.py:3090] [1/0] RuntimeError: Expected self.size(1) to be divisible by 16, but got self.size(1)=264
      (Worker_TP6 pid=488070) ERROR 10-13 04:32:25 [multiproc_executor.py:1062] torch._dynamo.exc.TorchRuntimeError: RuntimeError when making fake tensor call
      (EngineCore pid=487772) ERROR 10-13 04:32:26 [core.py:1495] RuntimeError: Worker failed with error 'RuntimeError when making fake tensor call
      RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {}
      ```

The evaluation of these layers crashes with the same kind of failure in all three models. These layers run `torch._scaled_mm` with `AITER `on or off, and `torch._scaled_mm` requires K to be a multiple of 16 for `hipBLASLt`; 1368 and 264 are not.

This PR zero-pads the weight's K up to a multiple of 16 after loading, and pads the FP8 input to match at runtime. The padded rows and columns are zeros, so the result does not change. Layers whose K is already a multiple of 16 are left alone. 

This PR applies to `ROCmFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel` and the `torch._scaled_mm` kernels (per-tensor, row-wise and channel-wise). CUTLASS on CUDA already pads the same way (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/41868):

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/fe341a53dda00472c281a2d1f4bd34a74e7eae6e/vllm/model_executor/kernels/linear/scaled_mm/cutlass.py#L206-L274

## Claims

- The three models start and serve at TP8 with AITER on and off, on MI300X and MI355X.
- GSM8K scores at TP8 with AITER on are in line with AITER off.

## Validation

| Model | Hugging Face model |
|---|---|
| RedHatAI DeepSeek | RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 |
| nm-testing DeepSeek | nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 |
| RedHatAI DiffusionGemma | RedHatAI/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic |

| # | GPU | Model | GSM8K strict-match, AITER on | GSM8K strict-match, AITER off | GSM8K flexible-extract, AITER on | GSM8K flexible-extract, AITER off |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MI300X | RedHatAI DeepSeek | 0.7521 ± 0.0119 | 0.7642 ± 0.0117 | 0.7657 ± 0.0117 | 0.7756 ± 0.0115 |
| 2 | MI300X | nm-testing DeepSeek | 0.7498 ± 0.0119 | 0.7710 ± 0.0116 | 0.7657 ± 0.0117 | 0.7824 ± 0.0114 |
| 3 | MI300X | RedHatAI DiffusionGemma | 0.6687 ± 0.0130 | 0.6899 ± 0.0127 | 0.6892 ± 0.0127 | 0.7240 ± 0.0123 |
| 4 | MI355X | RedHatAI DeepSeek | 0.7559 ± 0.0118 | 0.7635 ± 0.0117 | 0.7695 ± 0.0116 | 0.7710 ± 0.0116 |
| 5 | MI355X | nm-testing DeepSeek | 0.7604 ± 0.0118 | 0.7627 ± 0.0117 | 0.7726 ± 0.0115 | 0.7726 ± 0.0115 |
| 6 | MI355X | RedHatAI DiffusionGemma | 0.6717 ± 0.0129 | 0.6816 ± 0.0128 | 0.6922 ± 0.0127 | 0.6998 ± 0.0126 |

GSM8K scores are from running the commands below at TP8. The runs used this PR together with these two PRs, which the models need with AITER on and at TP8:

* https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61093 (AITER FP8 MoE padding)
* https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61155 (DiffusionGemma TP hang fix)

The commands are the same on both GPUs.

* Rows 1 and 4 (RedHatAI DeepSeek):
    * `vllm serve`, AITER on:
      ```
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 --dtype auto -tp 8 --port 8000 --disable-uvicorn-access-log --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 4096 --kv-cache-dtype auto
      ```
    * `vllm serve`, AITER off:

    * `lm_eval`:

* Rows 2 and 5 (nm-testing DeepSeek):
    * `vllm serve`, AITER on:
      ```
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 --dtype auto -tp 8 --port 8000 --disable-uvicorn-access-log --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 4096 --kv-cache-dtype auto
      ```
    * `vllm serve`, AITER off:
      ```
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=0 vllm serve nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 --dtype auto -tp 8 --port 8000 --disable-uvicorn-access-log --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 4096 --kv-cache-dtype auto
      ```
    * `lm_eval`:
      ```
      lm_eval --model local-completions --model_args model=nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=32,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size 32 --seed 42
      ```
* Rows 3 and 6 (RedHatAI DiffusionGemma):
    * `vllm serve`, AITER on:
      ```
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve RedHatAI/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic --dtype auto -tp 8 --port 8000 --disable-uvicorn-access-log --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 4096 --kv-cache-dtype auto
      ```
    * `vllm serve`, AITER off:
      ```
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=0 vllm serve RedHatAI/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic --dtype auto -tp 8 --port 8000 --disable-uvicorn-access-log --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 4096 --kv-cache-dtype auto
      ```
    * `lm_eval`:
      ```
      lm_eval --model local-completions --model_args model=RedHatAI/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=32,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size 32 --seed 42 --gen_kwargs temperature=1.0,seed=None
      ```

## Details

#### Performance

    * `vllm serve` (AITER on, then AITER off):

```bash
# ./serve_qwen3.sh <tp> <aiter 1|0>
MODEL=amd/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8
```

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/fe341a53dda00472c281a2d1f4bd34a74e7eae6e/vllm/model_executor/kernels/linear/scaled_mm/cutlass.py#L206-L274

- The three models start and serve at TP8 with AITER on and off, on MI300X and MI355X.
- GSM8K scores at TP8 with AITER on are in line with AITER off.
